business_problem: Transcend's rapid telehealth growth exposed manual eligibility checks, fragmented client data, and slow support workflows that made it hard to provide concierge wellness care while staying compliant and scaling efficiently.
solution_summary: Transcend is building an always-on telehealth support model with Agentforce, Atlas Reasoning Engine, Health Cloud, Revenue Cloud, and Data Cloud so clients can move through diagnosis, treatment, refill, and payment workflows with less manual intervention. Client information from treatment history, lab results, prescriptions, billing, and external partner systems is unified in Data Cloud and Health Cloud, giving Agentforce the context to answer questions, validate eligibility, and flag medication or family-history risks in real time. Atlas Reasoning Engine powers the decision layer, while Revenue Cloud and broader Salesforce workflows handle pricing approvals, payments, and order-cycle steps. By automating routine but safety-sensitive work and escalating edge cases to specialists, Transcend can preserve concierge care while increasing throughput and maintaining HIPAA-conscious controls.
data_flow: Treatment, lab, billing, and partner data is unified in Data Cloud and Health Cloud, where Agentforce and Atlas Reasoning Engine can validate client context, answer questions, flag risks, and either complete routine steps or escalate the case to wellness specialists with the relevant history attached.
business_outcome: Transcend expects faster response times, lower manual workload, fewer ordering errors, better compliance, and more capacity for specialists to focus on personalized wellness guidance instead of repetitive administration.
metrics: Improve response times by an estimated 30%
Specialists' time spent on manual work will drop by about 40%

Data Cloud's zero-copy integration is used to unify data with pharmacy and diagnostic partners like LabCorp.
